full_judgment: 3. The defendant contested the Other Class Suit No.88 of 1989 filling written statement contending, 'inter alia', that during the C.S. operation 0.86 decimals of land was recorded in the name of Jannat Ali, predecessors-in-interest of the plaintiffs in 16 (sixteen) annas share; that Profullah Kumar Sen as a Manager of the Court of Ward on behalf of the Zaminder Santosh Panch Ani filed a Rent Suit No.55 of 1942 in the 2nd Court of Munsif, Tangail and the suit was decreed on 26.03.1942 and subsequently the Execution Case No.133 of 1943 was started and in the said Execution Case land in suit was sold in auction which was purchased by Darog Ali who had been owning and possessing the same on payment of rent to the Government acquired estate; that earlier to the auction sale by the authority concerned and after the death of C.S. recorded tenant Jannat Ali his wife Rangbi Bewa who on her own behalf and on behalf of the minor son, Fatik Sk. and on behalf of her daughter Taluki Bibi sold 0.58 decimals of land of C.S. Plot No.1780 to the said Darog Ali by a registered kabla dated 20.12.1941 on consideration of TK.250.00; that thereafter, Sobhan SK. who is defendant No.1 purchase 0.58 decimals of land of C.S. Plot No.1780 from the said Darog Ali by a registered kabla dated 21.07.1943 at consideration of TK.300.00; that Sobhan SK. became owner of 0.58 decimals of land by way of kabla purchase; that the defendant No.2 took rayiati pattan of 0.28 decimals of land of C.S. Plot No.1701 on 23.02.1943; that in these way the defendants have became owner of the suit land; that the R.O.R. Khatian has been rightly prepared in the names of the defendants; that the plaintiffs have no title and possession therein; that the suit is barred by limitation; that the plaintiffs have filed the suit falsely and the suit is liable to be dismissed with cost.
